+#!/usr/bin/env python3
+"""Controlled CPU/FP32 HLLE comparisons, including real25day input."""
+import json
+import subprocess
+from pathlib import Path
+import numpy as np
+
+HERE = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
+OUT = HERE / "validation"
+ROOT = HERE.parents[1]
+CPU = HERE / "hlle_cpu/mhd_solver_hlle"
+GPU = HERE / "mhd_cuda_fp32_async_hlle"
+
+
+def options(path):
+    return dict(line.split("=", 1) for line in path.read_text().splitlines() if "=" in line)
+
+
+def config(name, backend, values):
+    values = dict(values)
+    values.update(threads=1, flux_variant="split_hlle", output_dir=OUT / f"hlle_{name}_{backend}")
+    path = OUT / f"hlle_{name}_{backend}.cfg"
+    path.write_text("".join(f"{key}={value}\n" for key, value in values.items()))
+    return path, Path(values["output_dir"])
+
+
+def compare(name, folders):
+    a = np.load(sorted(folders["cpu"].glob("snapshot_*.npy"))[-1]).astype(float)
+    b = np.load(sorted(folders["gpu"].glob("snapshot_*.npy"))[-1]).astype(float)
+    result = {"CPU": str(folders["cpu"]), "GPU": str(folders["gpu"]),
+              "snapshot_Linf_relative_to_field_Linf": (np.max(abs(a-b), axis=(0, 1, 2)) /
+                                                         (np.max(abs(a), axis=(0, 1, 2))+1e-30)).tolist(),
+              "CPU_statistics": json.loads((folders["cpu"] / "statistics.json").read_text()),
+              "FP32_statistics": json.loads((folders["gpu"] / "statistics.json").read_text())}
+    if name == "production_coarse":
+        dest = OUT / "hlle_production_coarse_GTI_comparison.json"
+        subprocess.run(["python", str(HERE.parent / "experiments/compare_variant.py"),
+                        str(folders["cpu"]), str(folders["gpu"]), str(dest)], check=True)
+        comparison = json.loads(dest.read_text())["GTI_comparisons"]["PN_only"]["probes"]["comet"]
+        result["PN_comet_comparison"] = comparison
+        for field in ["n_cm3", "speed_kms", "incident_flux_cm2_s"]:
+            assert comparison[field]["maximum_abs_relative_change_within_observation_span"] < .01, comparison
+    else:
+        assert max(result["snapshot_Linf_relative_to_field_Linf"]) < .001, result
+    (OUT / f"hlle_{name}_agreement.json").write_text(json.dumps(result, indent=2)+"\n")
+    print(name, json.dumps(result), flush=True)
+    return result
+
+
+def main():
+    # CPU production reference runs while the independent tiny cases execute.
+    coarse = options(ROOT / "results/coarse/run.cfg")
+    coarse.update(outer_magnetic_radial_scaling=1, snapshot_days=99, output_start_day=99)
+    path, folder = config("production_coarse", "cpu", coarse)
+    log = (OUT / "hlle_production_coarse_cpu.log").open("w")
+    proc = subprocess.Popen([str(CPU), "--config", str(path)], stdout=log, stderr=log)
+    results = {}
+    cases = {"uniform": options(OUT / "uniform_gpu.cfg"),
+             "inductive_cones": options(OUT / "cme_tiny_fp32.cfg")}
+    for name, values in cases.items():
+        folders = {}
+        for backend, exe in [("cpu", CPU), ("gpu", GPU)]:
+            path, folders[backend] = config(name, backend, values)
+            subprocess.run([str(exe), "--config", str(path)], check=True, timeout=120)
+        results[name] = compare(name, folders)
+    if proc.wait(timeout=300):
+        raise RuntimeError("HLLE CPU production control failed; inspect its log")
+    log.close()
+    path, gpu_folder = config("production_coarse", "gpu", coarse)
+    subprocess.run([str(GPU), "--config", str(path)], check=True, timeout=300)
+    results["production_coarse"] = compare("production_coarse", {"cpu": folder, "gpu": gpu_folder})
+    (OUT / "hlle_agreement_summary.json").write_text(json.dumps(results, indent=2)+"\n")
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    main()
*** End Patch"));
